name: economy
description: AI coding cost tracker — CLI + MCP + HTTP API (economy-serve) + generated SDK. The server data backend is sqlite | postgresql, selected by the presence of HASNA_ECONOMY_DATABASE_URL; with postgresql the serve process reads AND writes the shared PostgreSQL directly with API-key auth via @hasna/contracts. Hosted clients resolve their credential through the @hasna/contracts 1.0.2 resolver (Keychain, ~/.hasna/economy/config/credentials, HASNA_ECONOMY_API_KEY; default gateway https://api.hasna.com/economy) and fail closed with no credential.

pgTestGate.command: HASNA_ECONOMY_TEST_DATABASE_URL="${HASNA_ECONOMY_TEST_DATABASE_URL:?point it at a throwaway Postgres; the live-PG gate must not pass without one}" ECONOMY_REQUIRE_POSTGRES=1 bun test src/db/pg-live.test-harness.test.ts
